questions.question: How long does a customer have to request a full refund?

goldAnchors.phrase: may request a full refund within thirty days of the purchase date

questions.notes: Shares 'refund' with 2.2 and 2.3; the discriminator is 'full'.

questions.question: How many days does a customer have to start a hardware return?

goldAnchors.phrase: The customer has fourteen days from delivery to start a hardware return

questions.notes: Competes with the thirty-day refund window in 2.

questions.question: How quickly must support acknowledge a disputed refund?

goldAnchors.phrase: Support must acknowledge a disputed refund within three business days

questions.notes: 'business days' also appears in 3.2, 8.3 and 12.2.

questions.question: What is the first response target for a P1 ticket?

goldAnchors.phrase: A P1 ticket must receive its first human response within four hours

questions.notes: P1/P2/P3 targets all live in one subsection, so ranking within it matters.

questions.question: How long can a P3 ticket wait for its first response?

goldAnchors.phrase: P3 tickets must receive a first response within two business days

questions.notes: Same subsection as q-004; distinguishing P1 from P3 is the test.

questions.question: How far in advance must travel be booked?

goldAnchors.phrase: Bookings must be made at least twenty-one days before departure

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?

goldAnchors.phrase: Claims must be submitted within sixty days of the date the cost was incurred

questions.notes: Deliberately collides with the refund receipt rule on the token 'receipt'.

questions.question: Above what amount does an equipment purchase need director approval?

goldAnchors.phrase: Equipment purchases above seven hundred fifty dollars require director approval

questions.notes: Collides with the approval thresholds in 7.1.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do permanent employees get?

goldAnchors.phrase: Permanent employees receive twenty-five days of paid annual leave each calendar year

questions.question: How many public holidays does the company observe?

goldAnchors.phrase: The company observes eleven public holidays each year

questions.question: How long can an initial contractor engagement run?

goldAnchors.phrase: An initial contractor engagement may run for at most ninety days

questions.question: What are the payment terms for contractor invoices?

goldAnchors.phrase: Invoices are settled on net forty-five day terms

questions.notes: The reseller distractor states net thirty for partner invoices.

questions.question: How often are vendors reviewed?

goldAnchors.phrase: The recurring vendor review runs every eighteen months

questions.notes: 'review' also means the performance review in 11.1.

questions.question: What spending level requires director approval?

goldAnchors.phrase: Director approval is required for any commitment above five thousand dollars

questions.notes: Competes with the equipment threshold in 4.3.

questions.question: How far ahead must a delegate be recorded before planned leave?

goldAnchors.phrase: Delegation must be recorded at least two weeks before a planned absence begins

questions.question: How quickly must a Sev1 incident be acknowledged?

goldAnchors.phrase: acknowledged by the on-duty responder within fifteen minutes

questions.question: How often does the incident lead publish status updates?

goldAnchors.phrase: the incident lead publishes a status update every one hour

questions.question: When must a postmortem be published?

goldAnchors.phrase: The postmortem must be published within five business days

questions.question: How quickly are new starter accounts provisioned?

goldAnchors.phrase: New starter accounts are provisioned within one business day

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?

goldAnchors.phrase: Passwords must be at least sixteen characters long

questions.question: How long is restricted data retained?

goldAnchors.phrase: Restricted data is retained for seven years

questions.question: How often must office-based employees attend in person?

goldAnchors.phrase: attend in person at least two days per week

questions.question: How often are laptops replaced?

goldAnchors.phrase: Laptops are replaced on a thirty-six month cycle

questions.question: How much is the home office stipend?

goldAnchors.phrase: home office stipend of four hundred dollars

questions.question: How often does the formal performance review happen?

goldAnchors.phrase: The formal performance review runs every six months

questions.notes: 'review' collides with the vendor review in 6.3.

questions.question: What is the annual development budget per employee?

goldAnchors.phrase: annual development budget of twelve hundred dollars

questions.question: What notice period must a permanent employee give?

goldAnchors.phrase: Permanent employees give four weeks of written notice

questions.question: When is unreturned equipment recorded as outstanding?

goldAnchors.phrase: not returned within ten business days of the final working day

questions.question: When is final pay paid?

goldAnchors.phrase: It is paid within twenty-eight days of the final working day

questions.question: Who does a support agent escalate a ticket to first?

goldAnchors.phrase: The escalation path runs from the agent to the shift lead

questions.notes: Non-numeric lookup; 'escalation' also appears in 2 and 8.

questions.question: If a contractor needs a $900 laptop, who approves it and when do they get paid?

goldAnchors.phrase: Equipment purchases above seven hundred fifty dollars require director approval
Invoices are settled on net forty-five day terms

questions.notes: Evidence in two distant sections; needs at least two retrieved chunks.

questions.question: A customer alleges billing fraud in a refund dispute. Where does it go and how fast must it be acknowledged?

goldAnchors.phrase: Disputes that involve an allegation of billing fraud move immediately to Finance
acknowledged by the on-duty responder within fifteen minutes

questions.notes: Requires following the cross-reference from refunds into incident handling.

questions.question: An expense claim is ninety days old. What is needed to reimburse it?

goldAnchors.phrase: Claims submitted after that window need written approval from a director
Director approval is required for any commitment above five thousand dollars

questions.notes: Two different senses of director approval must both be retrieved.

questions.question: A new starter joins on Monday. When do they get their account, and how old can their laptop be?

goldAnchors.phrase: New starter accounts are provisioned within one business day
Laptops are replaced on a thirty-six month cycle

questions.question: Someone resigns. How much notice, and how long to return their laptop?

goldAnchors.phrase: Permanent employees give four weeks of written notice
not returned within ten business days of the final working day

questions.notes: Adjacent subsections; tests whether chunking keeps them separable.

questions.question: When must a leaver submit expenses, and when is final pay made?

goldAnchors.phrase: Outstanding expense claims must be submitted before the final working day
Claims must be submitted within sixty days of the date the cost was incurred

questions.notes: Pulls the general expense rule together with the leaver-specific one.

questions.question: A support agent suspects a security breach in a P1 ticket. Who do they contact and what severity applies?

goldAnchors.phrase: suspected security incidents, which go straight to the Security team
Sev1 means customer data is exposed or a service is entirely unavailable

questions.notes: The support escalation path has an explicit exception that must be found.

questions.question: A fully remote employee flies to a team gathering. How often is that funded and how early must they book?

goldAnchors.phrase: funded to travel to a team gathering twice a year
Bookings must be made at least twenty-one days before departure

questions.question: A vendor fails its review and the renewal is a three-year deal. What happens?

goldAnchors.phrase: the owning team must produce a remediation plan before the contract is renewed
Multi-year commitments always go to the executive team

questions.question: During a Sev1, who talks to customers and who does an agent escalate to?

goldAnchors.phrase: Customer-facing communication during an incident goes out through the Customer Operations lead
The escalation path runs from the agent to the shift lead

questions.question: A contractor engagement is being extended past its initial term. What is required and how are they billed?

goldAnchors.phrase: Extending beyond that requires a fresh statement of work
Contractors invoice monthly in arrears against the statement of work

questions.notes: Adjacent subsections sharing the phrase 'statement of work'.

questions.question: Is time spent on an approved course working time, and when are meetings scheduled?

goldAnchors.phrase: Time spent on approved training is working time
Core hours are ten in the morning to four in the afternoon

questions.question: How do employee stock options vest?
questions.notes: Equity is deliberately outside the handbook's scope.

questions.question: How much parental leave is offered?
questions.notes: Leave policy covers annual and sick leave only.

questions.question: Does the company provide dental insurance?
questions.notes: No benefits schedule appears in the handbook.

questions.question: What relocation assistance is available for a move?
questions.notes: Remote work is covered; relocation is not.

questions.question: Does the company sponsor work visas?
questions.notes: Supported countries are mentioned; immigration is not.

questions.question: How is on-call rotation compensated?
questions.notes: Incident duty is described, but never its compensation.

questions.question: Can I take a paid sabbatical after five years?
questions.notes: Long-service leave is not a handbook topic.

questions.question: What is the employer pension contribution rate?
questions.notes: Payroll mechanics beyond final pay are out of scope.
